html:
This full day experience combines island hopping, snorkeling, a world class water park, and an unforgettable cable car ride. Cable Car And 3 Islands Tour at Vietlook Travel takes guests to beautiful coral reefs for snorkeling, relaxing beaches at May Rut Trong Island, the exciting Aquatopia Water Park on Thom Island, and the world’s longest oversea cable car, offering spectacular panoramic views of Phu Quoc’s islands, fishing villages, and turquoise waters.

Highlights

  • Snorkeling at Xuong (Gam Ghi) Island’s coral reef area

  • Free time at May Rut Trong Island for swimming and beach activities

  • Entrance to Aquatopia Water Park with more than 20 international-standard water games

  • Ride the world’s longest oversea cable car with breathtaking aerial views

  • Lunch served on board

Itinerary

08:15 – 08:30

Pick up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward (for hotels outside this area, please contact us in advance).

Transfer to An Thoi Harbor.

Board the boat and start visiting the most popular islands in the south of Phu Quoc.

Xuong Island (or Gam Ghi Island)

Snorkeling and swimming at an unspoiled coral reef area with a wide variety of coral species.

Lunch on Board

Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch while relaxing on the boat.

May Rut Trong Island

Free time to relax, swim, stroll along the white sand beach, enjoy drinks at the beach bar, sunbathe under coconut trees, or take photos.

Thom Island – Aquatopia Water Park

Explore Aquatopia Water Park with more than 20 modern games and 6 themed adventure zones.

Thom Island Cable Car

Experience the cable car ride for approximately 25 minutes, enjoying panoramic views of the sea, islands, fishing villages, and coastal scenery from above.

17:30

Return to the hotel. End of tour.

Tour Price

  • Adult: USD 46 / pax (from 1.4 m in height)

  • Children (1.0 m – under 1.4 m): USD 38 / pax

  • Children under 1.0 m: Free of charge

Tour Includes

  • Round-trip transportation by car and boat

  • Cable car and Aquatopia Water Park entrance tickets

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Lunch

  • 1 bottle of water per person

  • Snorkeling equipment (mask, snorkel, fins subject to size availability)

  • Life jackets

Tour Excludes

  • Personal expenses

  • Additional services at cable car and islands

Important Notes

  • The tour guide will arrange the cable car schedule depending on actual conditions.

  • In case of Aquatopia Water Park maintenance, guests will still experience the cable car; tour price remains unchanged.

  • Island order may be adjusted depending on weather and sea conditions.

  • Swimwear is required for the water park (no zippers or buttons).

  • Please bring towels, spare clothes, suitable footwear, eco-friendly sunscreen, and some cash.

Lunch Menu

  • Steamed shrimp

  • Sweet and sour squid

  • Braised fish in clay pot

  • Vegetable soup with minced pork

  • Deep-fried tofu with lemongrass

  • Stir-fried morning glory with garlic

  • Omelette

  • Steamed rice

  • Fresh fruit

Vegetarian, vegan, and children’s meals are available upon request at least 24 hours before departure.

Children’s Pricing Policy

  • Children aged 10 and above: adult price

  • Children aged 5–9: 50% of adult price

  • Children under 5: free of charge

Payment Policy

Groups of 1–5 guests:

  • 50% deposit upon booking

  • Balance payable no later than 1 day before or on the tour day

Groups of 6 guests or more:

  • 50% deposit upon booking

  • Balance payable no later than 1 day before the tour date

Cancellation Policy

Groups of 1–5 guests:

  • Cancellation 1 day before tour date: free of charge

  • Cancellation on tour date: 100% charge

Groups of 6 guests or more:

  • Cancellation 2 days before tour date: free of charge

  • Cancellation 1 day before tour date: 50% charge

  • Cancellation on tour date: 100% charge

Weather-related cancellations:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow departure, Vietlook Travel will cancel and provide a full refund.

  • If the tour is permitted to operate and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

Health And Safety

  • Not recommended for guests with limited mobility or serious medical conditions.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult their doctors before joining.

  • Guests must follow all safety instructions provided by the tour guide and operators.
